brand_identity.concept: Asset-light real estate platform & ERP for Erode & Perundurai, Tamil Nadu
brand_identity.currency_format: Indian Rupees (₹ Lakhs / Crores for sales, ₹/mo for rentals)

typography.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

public_site.header: Fixed/Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200. Clear wordmark 'Sellandiamman Estates', navigation links (Home, Catalogue, Services, Submissions, About, Contact), and CTA 'ERP Login' / 'Submit Property'
public_site.hero: Clean hero with high-contrast search bar (Location: Erode/Perundurai, Type: Land/Residential/Commercial/Rental, Price Range), background image or subtle grid pattern
public_site.grid: Grid layout grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8
public_site.card_style: Minimalist card, sharp/subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg), 1px slate border (border-slate-200), zero glossy gradients, generous interior padding (p-5 or p-6), explicit image container max-h-[240px]
public_site.footer: Deep charcoal background (bg-slate-900) with white/slate-300 text, disclaimers, WhatsApp quick link, Erode & Perundurai office details, privacy policy, cookie consent

erp_dashboard.sidebar: Clean dark slate (bg-slate-900 text-slate-300) or clean crisp white sidebar with 1px right border. Displays active role switcher, module links, user status
erp_dashboard.kpi_cards: Flat rectangular widgets with 1px border, large crisp bold numbers (₹ format), subtle growth badges, density-first layout
erp_dashboard.tables: High density, clear column headers, alternate row subtle shading (hover:bg-slate-50), explicit pagination, status badges, action dropdowns
erp_dashboard.pipeline: Kanban columns (Leads, Contacted, Site Visit Scheduled, Negotiation, Closed/Invoiced) with lead drag/move controls

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or clean rectangular with rounded-md. Dark charcoal primary button (bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800), outlined secondary button (border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50). Explicit data-testid on all buttons.
component_guidelines.badges: Flat background with muted text border, e.g. bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 for 'Verified' or 'Available'.
component_guidelines.forms: Structured labels above input fields, crisp 1px slate border (border-slate-300 focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-900), clear validation and success feedback.
component_guidelines.modal_dialogs: White background, backdrop bg-slate-900/40, sticky header/footer for forms with action buttons.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, input fields, navigation links, KPI blocks, role tabs, filter controls, and property cards must feature explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-location-select', data-testid='property-card-101', data-testid='erp-role-switcher').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark blue gradients or bright neon AI slop styling. Maintain ultra-clean white/light backgrounds with slate charcoal text.
All monetary amounts must use Indian Rupee (₹) standard notation (e.g., ₹45,00,000 or ₹45 Lakhs, ₹1.5 Crores).
Public site and ERP dashboard must coexist seamlessly with common state and simulated/backend data APIs.
Include explicit data-testid attributes on every interactive element and data card.
Ensure total accessibility, standard contrast compliance (APCA / WCAG 4.5:1), and mobile responsive design.
